title: Influee Alternatives That Deliver Finished Video Ads in 2026
summary: Influee alternatives for finished ads, compared on published terms: AI video ads from Knowlify, plus managed creator services and self-serve creator credits.

## Which real-creator services deliver finished videos?


The table lists creator services that deliver finished videos on published terms. Influee itself is a marketplace where creators apply to your campaign; the options below describe more of the sourcing and production as theirs. For more creator platforms, see our guide to the[best UGC platforms for brands](https://knowlify.com/articles/best-ugc-platforms-for-brands) .


Provider Model Published terms (October 2026) Pick it when


Knowlify Done-for-you AI video ads, no real creators About 25 finished ads a week; custom quote You need finished ads and no real person on camera


[Insense](https://insense.pro/services/ready-to-go-ugc-videos) Managed UGC rounds with creators From $3,500 per round of 8 videos on a 3-month commitment; creator costs and full digital usage rights included You want recurring rounds of creator ads


[Billo](https://billo.app/blog/how-billo-pricing-works/) Managed service on a creator platform Managed service from $2,000 a month, billed monthly in advance; videos from $99 each You want a team to source and brief creators


[minisocial](https://minisocial.com/) Managed micro-creator campaigns From $3,000 for 10 creators, creator fees included; typically 4 to 6 weeks You want many real people featuring the product


[Trend](https://www.trend.io/pricing) Self-serve platform with prepaid creator credits $550 for up to 6 videos; $3,872 for up to 56; credits expire after 12 months You want a scoped batch and will manage the brief


[Brighter Click](https://www.brighterclick.com/ugc-agency) Fixed batch of edited creator videos $4,500 for 12 edited videos from 4 creators; 10 to 14 business days You want a known number of finished creator ads at a known price


Billo's managed team sources, briefs and manages creators, reviews every video, and can add captions, music and effects in post-production. Trend's credit counts assume the lowest creator tier, so check which tier your videos would use. Insense's package includes two revisions after delivery, which is worth comparing against the revision terms of any marketplace you are weighing.


## What is different when you replace a creator marketplace?


Replacing a marketplace changes who does the work, not necessarily the result. If the bottleneck is the brief, the editing or the approval, a new platform will not fix it. Ask who writes the brief, who edits the cut and who signs off on product claims before you move the budget.


Rights matter as much as price. Ads that run from a creator's handle depend on permissions from that creator, and Meta's partnership ads documentation points to separate post-level and account-level permissioning guides. Confirm which permission you will hold, for how long, and the usage period in writing for every replacement.


"Finished" should also mean placement-ready. Meta's aspect ratio guidance recommends 9:16 for the full-screen vertical placements, so ask each provider for vertical exports and check the cut in the Ads Manager preview.[Meta aspect ratio guidance](https://www.facebook.com/business/help/103816146375741) Influee's homepage describes one-click format changes for Reels, TikTok, Feed and square, so test that against a real export before you rely on it.


Creator videos also need disclosure of any material relationship between the brand and the creator, which the FTC's influencer guidance covers.[FTC disclosures](https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/resources/disclosures-101-social-media-influencers) Any personal experience in the script has to be truthful as well. Put both requirements in the brief, so a provider cannot treat them as a finishing step.


## Key takeaways


- Knowlify is our top pick when you need finished ads and no real person on camera.
- Influee is a creator marketplace where creators apply to your campaign, and its creator fees and platform fees are separate costs.
- Insense, Billo, minisocial, Trend and Brighter Click differ on minimums, commitments and who handles the brief.
- Compare every option against one finished, approved video rather than a headline per-video price.
- Confirm usage rights, handle permissions and creator disclosures before the first ad runs.


## FAQ


### What is the best Influee alternative for finished ads?


Knowlify is our top pick if the ads can be AI video with no real creator on camera. It makes finished ads, a person checks each one, and it can run campaigns or deliver creative only. If you need real creators, compare Billo or Insense, which take on the creator work for you.


### Is Influee a managed service?


Its homepage does not describe it as one. It describes a marketplace where creators apply to your campaign, with Influee vetting creators and handling contracts, rights and payments, and it does not say it runs paid ad campaigns for you. Get the scope in writing, including who briefs, who edits, who approves and who runs the ads.


### Are Influee's prices all-in?


Not from the published terms. Its pricing page lists creator payments separately, with a 10% marketplace fee on top of the subscription. Ask for the all-in cost of one approved video, including the creator fee, editing, revisions and usage rights.


### Do I still need my own team with a managed service?


Yes, for decisions. A managed service removes sourcing and editing work, but someone on your side still has to approve product claims, pick the creator and choose which cut runs. Name that approver before the first batch.
